# `mask`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
mask(input[, upperChar, lowerChar, digitChar, otherChar])
```

masks the given string value.
The function replaces characters with 'X' or 'x', and numbers with 'n'.
This can be useful for creating copies of tables with sensitive information removed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- mask, example 1
> SELECT mask('abcd-EFGH-8765-4321');
xxxx-XXXX-nnnn-nnnn
```

```sql
-- mask, example 2
> SELECT mask('abcd-EFGH-8765-4321', 'Q');
xxxx-QQQQ-nnnn-nnnn
```

```sql
-- mask, example 3
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q');
QqQQnnn-@$#
```

```sql
-- mask, example 4
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#');
XxXXnnn-@$#
```

```sql
-- mask, example 5
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q');
QxQQnnn-@$#
```

```sql
-- mask, example 6
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q');
QqQQnnn-@$#
```

```sql
-- mask, example 7
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q', 'd');
QqQQddd-@$#
```

```sql
-- mask, example 8
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', 'Q', 'q', 'd', 'o');
QqQQdddoooo
```

```sql
-- mask, example 9
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, 'q', 'd', 'o');
AqCDdddoooo
```

```sql
-- mask, example 10
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, 'd', 'o');
```

```sql
-- mask, example 11
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, NULL, 'o');

```

```sql
-- mask, example 12
```

```sql
-- mask, example 13
> SELECT mask(NULL);

```

```sql
-- mask, example 14
> SELECT mask('AbCD123-@$#', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);
```
